text:
lina: quick check — onboarding zephyr-7b-v2 hit a few serve-gate issues, can anyone triage?
omar: saw the lint failures, pushing a minimal PR now. what's failing exactly?
lina: config-lint reports mismatched vocab_size and missing pad_token_id. also weights_uri is a gs:// path but our deploy expects s3:// or signed-gcs.
configbot: rbin config-lint results for models/zephyr-7b-v2/config.json:
```
ERROR: tokenizer.vocab_size (50257) != weights.meta.vocab_size (50400)
WARN: missing field tokenizer.pad_token_id (recommended for serving)
ERROR: weights_uri must be in approved asset store (s3://redwood-assets/ or gs://redwood-shared/)
```
miguel: the weights came from an experiment bucket (gs://redwood-models-temp). we should copy to gs://redwood-shared/ and update the URI. i'll handle the copy.
ciara: on the tokenizer side, the model was exported with a merged merges table — subtoken mapping shifted by two. quick diff looked like special token offsets changed. we need to confirm special tokens mapping so KV cache indexing stays correct.
omar: thanks. i'll open a PR that: 1) updates weights_uri to gs://redwood-shared/zephyr-7b-v2/weights.pt 2) adds tokenizer.pad_token_id: 1 3) adds a config-level compatibility note: "tokenizer_offset_hint": "+2" (temporary)
lina: prefer not to rely on a hint. can ci run a small sample decode against the weights to verify token mappings? if decode mismatch, fail the gate.
configbot: running quick-smoke decode with sample input 'Hello world'...
configbot: smoke-decode output: "Hello world" -> "Hello world\n" (tokenized ids mismatched by 2 at positions 3..5)
ciara: confirmed mismatch. we should include a transform in the tokenizer loader: if tokenizer.vocab_size != weights.meta.vocab_size then try to map using offsets from special tokens, but that is hacky. better to re-export tokenizer from the original artifact.
miguel: i have access to the experiment workspace. re-exporting tokenizer now and will put both tokenizer.json and weights into gs://redwood-shared/zephyr-7b-v2/release-2026-03-17/
omar: i'll pause the PR, then update after you upload. can someone add a pre-merge lint rule to reject weights_uri pointing at temp buckets? we've seen this slip before.
lina: agreed. add rule: approved_asset_prefixes: ["s3://redwood-assets/", "gs://redwood-shared/"] and fail CI if not matched.
ciara: also add a unit test: run decode of short prompt and assert normalized text == golden. lightweight (100ms) but catches tokenizer/weights parity.
miguel: upload done: gs://redwood-shared/zephyr-7b-v2/release-2026-03-17/{weights.pt,tokenizer.json} — checksum: sha256:abc123...
configbot: new asset path verified against allowlist.
configbot: re-running config-lint...
```
SUCCESS: tokenizer.vocab_size (50400) == weights.meta.vocab_size (50400)
INFO: tokenizer.pad_token_id present (1)
INFO: weights_uri in approved asset store
```
omar: PR #4887 updated to point at release path and added pad_token_id + smoke decode test. requesting review from @ciara and @lina.
lina: reviewing now. quick nit: please move the smoke test into tests/quick_smoke/ so CI can mark it as fast. also please include the golden for 'Hello world' as normalized string.
ciara: approving after that change. also add a one-liner in the model manifest: "onboarded_by": "miguel" and "onboarded_at": "2026-03-17" for auditability.
miguel: added manifest fields and updated PR.
omar: thanks all — once merged i'll trigger a canary deploy to staging and run end-to-end traces. tagging for follow-up: @lina (validation), @ciara (tokenizer), @miguel (assets). :thumbsup:
lina: thanks team, moving to done-once-pr-merged. if smoke decodes in staging look good i'll sign off for production rollout.
ciara: any ETA for canary?
miguel: I'll schedule copy and smoke checks tonight; expect canary tomorrow morning PST.
omar: noted. will watch the deploy and post results here.
lina: closing the loop — great cross-collab.
